info.name: AIBUS — guided public integration tests
info.description: Use only an isolated non-production API, partner credential and authorized test inventory. The booking flow uses Razorpay Test Mode; no real money is collected. Run the test order step, complete Razorpay Checkout in your integration, then enter its payment ID/signature before verification. Cancellation requires operator review; test refunds use the existing worker.
